findings.value: The council's hire listing says all of its spaces, cinemas included, are fully accessible to hire. A visitor guide says wheelchair access is limited. The two conflict, and the venue's own access page could not be read.

evidence.quote: All our spaces (including our 3 cinema screens) are available for hire and are fully accessible.

accessibility.step_free (no public statement; the sources conflict)
notes: Address, postcode and capacity from the venue's DICE page, read today. DICE's 370 is the whole-venue figure; the council hire page gives 350 standing for the main space. Time Out (17 Sept 2026, not re-read here) reports the cinema paused for 12 months while the building stays open for gigs; DICE lists events on sale for 17 Oct, 1 Nov, 11 Nov, 14 Nov, and 28 Nov 2026, so status is for the editor. Access statements are undated.
